# HackHouse Gurgaon

> HackHouse is a curated co-living space for founders, developers, and builders in Sector 50, Gurgaon, India. Each cohort is limited to 8 curated residents. The fee is Rs 35,000/month all-inclusive and covers a fully-furnished double-sharing room, 3 daily meals, 1 Gbps internet with 24x7 power backup, shared access to 15+ premium AI tools (worth Rs 20,000+/month), weekly mentorship, and a builder community. The minimum stay is 1 month.

HackHouse is not a regular PG. It is a builder-first co-living space where every resident is actively building a startup, side project, or open-source tool. Residents get shared access to Claude Max, ChatGPT Business, Cursor Pro, Midjourney, and 15+ premium tools, plus weekly mentorship and demo day prep.

## Key facts

- Location: Sector 50, Gurgaon, Haryana, India (Delhi NCR)
- Price: Rs 35,000/month, all-inclusive (co-living membership)
- Co-working passes: Rs 500/day, Rs 5,000/month
- Cohort size: 8 curated builders
- Minimum stay: 1 month (most stay 2-6 months)
- Internet: 1 Gbps fiber with 24x7 backup
- Meals: 3 daily (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
- AI tools: 15+ premium tools shared (Claude Max, Cursor Pro, ChatGPT Business, Midjourney, etc.)
- Contact: +91-9999900876, hello@hackhouse.in
- Application: 4 steps - apply online, 15-min chat, selected within 48 hours, move in
- Refund: pro-rated refund for unused days within first week
